title: Shopping
subtitle: 쇼핑
review: Written by Claude. The Korean and the romanization have not been checked by a Korean speaker. The Burmese explanations are drafts by Claude: check them. Check before recording audio.

categories.desc: Prices, and whether the shop has what you want.
cards: Igeo eolmayeyo?
How much is this?

이거 얼마예요?

Igeo: this. Geugeo: that (near you). Jeogeo: that over there.

Jeogiyo, i usan eolmayeyo?
저기요, 이 우산 얼마예요?
Excuse me, how much is this umbrella?

my: ဒါ ဘယ်လောက်လဲ။

이거 얼마예요?

Igeo: ဒါ။ Geugeo: အဲဒါ (တစ်ဖက်လူအနားက)။ Jeogeo: ဟိုဟာ (ဟိုးဘက်က)။
တဆိတ်လောက်၊ ဒီထီး ဘယ်လောက်လဲ။

cards: Upyo isseoyo?
Do you have stamps?

우표 있어요?

A thing + isseoyo?: do you have…? The answer no is eopseoyo.

Chungjeongi isseoyo? — Ne, isseoyo.
충전기 있어요? — 네, 있어요.
Do you have a charger? — Yes, we do.

my:
우표 있어요?

ပစ္စည်း + isseoyo?: …ရှိလား။ မရှိဘူးဆိုရင် eopseoyo လို့ ဖြေတယ်။

cards: Geunyang boneun geoyeyo.
I'm just looking.

그냥 보는 거예요.

For when the staff come over to help.

Mwo chajeuseyo? — Geunyang boneun geoyeyo.
뭐 찾으세요? — 그냥 보는 거예요.
Are you looking for something? — I'm just looking.

my: ကြည့်ရုံ ကြည့်နေတာပါ။

그냥 보는 거예요.

ဝန်ထမ်းက ကူညီဖို့ လာမေးတဲ့အခါ ပြန်ဖြေတဲ့ စကားပါ။

cards: Dareun saek isseoyo?
Do you have another colour?

다른 색 있어요?

Dareun: other.

Dareun saek isseoyo? — Geomjeongsaegirang hinsaegi isseoyo.
다른 색 있어요? — 검정색이랑 흰색이 있어요.
Do you have another colour? — We have black and white.

my:
다른 색 있어요?

Dareun: တခြား။
တခြားအရောင် ရှိလား။ — အနက်နဲ့ အဖြူ ရှိပါတယ်။

categories.desc: Too expensive, too small, and making up your mind.
cards: Jom bissayo.
It's a little expensive.

좀 비싸요.

Bissayo: expensive. Ssayo: cheap.

Jom bissayo. Deo ssan geo isseoyo?
좀 비싸요. 더 싼 거 있어요?
It's a little expensive. Do you have a cheaper one?

my: နည်းနည်း ဈေးကြီးတယ်။

좀 비싸요.

Bissayo: ဈေးကြီးတယ်။ Ssayo: ဈေးပေါတယ်။
နည်းနည်း ဈေးကြီးတယ်။ ဒီထက် ဈေးသက်သာတာ ရှိလား။

cards: Ibeo bwado dwaeyo?
May I try it on?

입어 봐도 돼요?

For clothes. For shoes: Sineo bwado dwaeyo?

Igeo ibeo bwado dwaeyo? — Ne, ibeo boseyo.
이거 입어 봐도 돼요? — 네, 입어 보세요.
May I try this on? — Yes, go ahead.

my: ဝတ်ကြည့်လို့ရမလား။

입어 봐도 돼요?

အဝတ်အစားအတွက်ပါ။ ဖိနပ်အတွက်: Sineo bwado dwaeyo?
ဒါ ဝတ်ကြည့်လို့ရမလား။ — ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ ရပါတယ်။

cards: Deo keun geo isseoyo?
Do you have a bigger one?

더 큰 거 있어요?

A smaller one: deo jageun geo.

Jom jagayo. Deo keun geo isseoyo?
좀 작아요. 더 큰 거 있어요?
It's a little small. Do you have a bigger one?

my:
더 큰 거 있어요?

ဒီထက်သေးတာ: deo jageun geo။
နည်းနည်း သေးတယ်။ ဒီထက်ကြီးတာ ရှိလား။

cards: Igeollo halgeyo.
I'll take this one.

이걸로 할게요.

A thing + -ro or -euro halgeyo: I'll go with…

Geureom igeollo halgeyo.
그럼 이걸로 할게요.
Then I'll take this one.

my: ဒါ ယူမယ်။

이걸로 할게요.

ပစ္စည်း + -ro ဒါမှမဟုတ် -euro halgeyo: …ကို ရွေးလိုက်မယ်။
ဒါဆို ဒါ ယူမယ်။

cards: Kadeu dwaeyo?
Can I pay by card?

카드 돼요?

'Does card work?' Cash: hyeongeum.

Kadeu dwaeyo? — Ne, dwaeyo.
카드 돼요? — 네, 돼요.
Can I pay by card? — Yes, you can.

my:
카드 돼요?

'ကတ် ရလား' လို့ အဓိပ္ပာယ်ရတယ်။ ငွေသား: hyeongeum။
ကတ်နဲ့ ပေးလို့ရလား။ — ဟုတ်ကဲ့၊ ရပါတယ်။

cards: Bongtu piryo eopseoyo.
I don't need a bag.

봉투 필요 없어요.

The staff ask: Bongtu deurilkkayo? (Would you like a bag?)

Bongtu deurilkkayo? — Anieyo, piryo eopseoyo.
봉투 드릴까요? — 아니에요, 필요 없어요.
Would you like a bag? — No, I don't need one.

my: အိတ် မလိုပါဘူး။

봉투 필요 없어요.

ဝန်ထမ်းက မေးတယ်: Bongtu deurilkkayo? (အိတ် ပေးရမလား။)
အိတ် ယူမလား။ — မလိုပါဘူး။

cards: Yeongsujeung juseyo.
The receipt, please.

영수증 주세요.

Yeongsujeung: receipt.

Yeongsujeung jom juseyo.
영수증 좀 주세요.
The receipt, please.

my:
영수증 주세요.

Yeongsujeung: ပြေစာ။

cards: Jeonbu eolmayeyo?
How much is it altogether?

전부 얼마예요?

Jeonbu: all of it.

Jeonbu eolmayeyo? — Samman wonieyo.
전부 얼마예요? — 삼만 원이에요.
How much altogether? — 30,000 won.

my:
전부 얼마예요?

Jeonbu: အားလုံး။
